?? PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE POST BEFORE CONTACTING ME.

I am looking for a serious and reliable sourcing agent to help me find premium or high-end duffle bags / travel bags for my e-commerce brand, with the possibility of building a long-term collaboration.

?? If you are interested, please contact me directly via private message with all the necessary information as well as your model proposals in your very first message.

In order to avoid unnecessary exchanges and not waste each other?s time, please make sure that you can meet the criteria below before contacting me.

?? PRODUCTS WANTED

I am looking for elegant, chic and modern duffle bags, with a truly premium appearance.

The bags must be practical, spacious and offer plenty of storage, including:

? Large main compartment
? Multiple interior pockets
? Zipped pockets
? Exterior pockets if possible
? Separate compartments when available
? Large overall capacity
? Strong handles and reinforced stitching
? Quality zippers and hardware
? Adjustable/removable shoulder strap if available

I am interested in genuine leather as well as high-quality PU / imitation leather materials, provided that the overall look is genuinely high-end.

?? COLORS WANTED

- Brown
- Camel / Caramel
- Black
- Bordeaux / Burgundy
- Dark green

Other elegant and neutral colors may also be proposed if they match the style I am looking for.

?? MOQ & SHIPPING

MOQ OF 1 UNIT REQUIRED TO START.

I need to be able to test the products individually before moving on to larger quantities or customized production.

Please specify:

? MOQ per model / color
? Sample price
? Shipping costs to Europe
? Shipping method
? Actual delivery time to Europe ? target: 3 to 7 days maximum
? Stock availability and restocking lead time

???? EUROPEAN COMPLIANCE ? MANDATORY

The products must comply with the requirements and regulations applicable in the European Union.

?? Relevant compliance documents must be available and verifiable BEFORE placing any order.

Please specify which documents are available and confirm that they apply to the exact models you are proposing.

??? BRANDING & PACKAGING

I also wish to develop my own branding in the future.

Please indicate whether you offer:

? Custom logo / private label
? Custom packaging
? Dust bags / boxes
? Labels / tags / cards
? MOQ and prices for customization

?? INFORMATION TO SEND IN YOUR FIRST MESSAGE

Please send me directly:

1. Your experience / references
2. Your experience with premium or high-end bags
3. Models from your catalog that match my requirements
4. REAL photos and videos of the products
5. Prices / price ranges
6. MOQ
7. Sample price
8. Shipping costs and actual delivery time to Europe
9. Stock information
10. European compliance information / documents
11. Branding and packaging possibilities
12. Your contact method: WhatsApp / email, etc.

?? All the criteria mentioned in this post are important, especially MOQ 1, European compliance, delivery time, storage capacity, quality and price.

Therefore, please read the entire post carefully before contacting me and only contact me if you are genuinely able to meet these requirements.

I am looking for a reliable sourcing partner for a long-term collaboration, not simply a one-time purchase.

Thank you ??
